editorial.name: SavvyCal
editorial.descriptionZh: 排期工具 SavvyCal 的官网首页，页眉字标写作 SavvyCal Meetings。它用一张高保真周视图替掉先点日期再点时间的老式预约界面，并让受邀方把自己的日历叠在你的可约时间上挑时段。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看预约链接怎么让受邀方叠上自己的日历选时间
editorial.noteZh: 整屏深绿底，右下角有同心圆水波纹，导航是 SavvyCal Meetings 字标加 Features、Pricing、What's New，右侧浅绿描边 Sign up。首屏中央是淡绿色特粗衬线大字 The fresh way to find a time to meet.，副标题写 You'll love it for the flexible controls to keep your calendar sane. They'll love it for the ultra-convenient booking experience.，按钮 Try SavvyCal risk-free 下面压一句 Join over 2,000 happy customers。往下按 SCHEDULING EXPERIENCE、OPTIMIZED AVAILABILITY、TEAM SCHEDULING 三块分组：第一块讲 Branding、Custom Domains、Calendar Overlay，第二块讲 Buffers & Limits、Time Blocking、Preferred Slots，第三块讲 Collective Mode、Round Robin Mode、Group Mode，每项后面带 Read more。三块之间夹着 Whereby 创始人 Ingrid Ødegaard 与 Dover 联合创始人 Anvisha Pai 两段用户引语。
editorial.pricing: Freemium（首页写 Kick the tires for free and upgrade when you're ready，档位在 /pricing）

reasons.statement: 这是 SavvyCal 排期工具的官网首页，交付功能分组说明、用户引语与 Try SavvyCal risk-free 入口，导航为 Features、Pricing、What's New。
归 product-company-sites 而非 creation-tools：预约链接要在注册后建立，首页本身只做功能展示与试用引导。
